$comment: First-load JS budgets (gzip level 9, KB = 1024 bytes) per app route, checked by scripts/size-report.mjs. The longest matching prefix in `routes` wins ("/" matches only the home route), otherwise `default` applies. Next.js internal routes (/_not-found, /_global-error) are reported but not budgeted. The L0 spec asked for 130 KB (events), but the Next.js 16.3 + React 19.3 App Router runtime alone measures 129.5 KB on an empty page (Turbopack; 128 KB with webpack), so the default sits just above that floor: events 140 KB, pending a decision (see README).

events.$comment: Didit Events: staff admin + public guest pages. Framework floor 129.5 KB.
events.$comment_routes: U5 guest flows: /login (Didit email-code sign-in), /e/[slug]/register (details + code), the cancel/withdraw sheets, edit profile, photo crop and delete account are client forms (useActionState, the 6-box code input, live validation, the canvas crop). They render the whole 390 guest screen on the client (logo, cover photo, icons), measured 143.7–147.6 KB on macOS; 152 KB keeps the ≥2 KB Linux-CI margin. Every other U5 route stays under the 140 KB default.
events.$comment_routes_admin: Lane U2 admin (measured on macOS 2026-09-29; Linux CI gzip runs ~1.6 KB heavier, so each budget keeps >=3 KB margin). /admin: the staff chrome (sidebar, session-expired modal with focus trap, offline banner, toast region) is ~8 KB over the framework floor (/admin/forbidden 137.4 KB); the interactive tabs add form controls or the C-00 DataTable (edit/new 144.0, settings 144.1, kiosks 143.2, log 144.8). /admin/events/[id]/guests: the guests table adds selection, sort, pager and per-row menus (156.0 KB); the drawer and the add-guests modal load on demand (next/dynamic).
events.$comment_routes_log_guests: U3 rework: /admin/events/[id]/log 152 KB and /admin/events/[id]/guests 164 KB. Linux CI gzip ~1.6 KB heavier; margin >= 4 KB.
events.$comment_routes_applicants: Lane U3 (measured on macOS 2026-09-29). /admin/events/[id]/applicants 154.6 KB: the review table is one client island (selection + bulk bar, per-row approve/waitlist/reject with busy and error states, J/K/A/W/R keyboard review, the capacity / bulk-approve / reject dialogs with focus traps, the undo toast); the drawer and the invite modal load on demand (next/dynamic). /admin/events/[id]/settings 146.7 KB: A-11 plus the AP-27 requirements entry (the modal itself loads on demand); 150 keeps the >=3 KB Linux-CI margin.
events.$comment_routes_event_page: B1 (2026-09-29): /e/[slug] 140.6 KB on macOS after the verification pending/retry state; Linux CI gzip ~1.6 KB heavier, so 146 KB keeps >=4 KB margin.
events.$comment_routes_applicants_p1: P1 (2026-09-30): applicants 156.6 KB on macOS after optimistic moves; Linux CI gzip ~1.6 KB heavier, 162 KB keeps >=4 KB margin.
events.$comment_routes_calendar_profile_2026_09: Calendar profile lane (measured on macOS 2026-09-30, Turbopack): /admin/events/new and /admin/events/[id]/edit 153.0 KB. The date picker's month grid is already code-split (loads on first open); the rest is the A-03 addendum's per-field controls that render on first paint: combobox (time slots, searchable timezone, Google Maps location), the capacity stepper, structured address fields and the shared client/server validation (~7.8 KB). Budget = measured + 3 KB for Linux CI gzip. /admin/calendar 146.5 KB (profile form + live P-03 header preview) gets 150 so it keeps >=3 KB margin instead of 1.5 KB under the /admin default.
events.$comment_routes_event_model_v2: Lane B event model v2 editor (measured on macOS 2026-09-30 against the same-commit baseline 153.6 KB): /admin/events/new and /admin/events/[id]/edit 158.9 KB. Six sections on one page; Description (Markdown), Registration form, Verification, Door, Emails and the leave guard are React.lazy chunks, so first load adds only the v2 values/validation shared with the save action (~3.5 KB) and the stored-cover uploader (~1.6 KB). Budget = measured + 3 KB for Linux CI gzip.
events.$comment_routes_2026_09_30: The 2026-09-30 edits (header account menu + photo avatars, request form, applicant review, staff email code) measured on macOS after code-splitting the AccountMenu: / and /events 145.0, /e/[slug] 154.4, register 164.2, v/[token] 149.2, login 152.1, cancel/withdraw 153.1, profile/edit 154.5, me/events/[slug] and verification 140.2, applicants 169.6. Each budget keeps >=3 KB for Linux CI gzip.
events.$comment_routes_onboarding_v2: New v2 onboarding route: measured 155.6 KiB gzip on macOS, with profile editing, resumable face verification and polling. Explicit 159 KiB budget keeps 3.4 KiB platform margin, comparable to /me/profile/edit (158); existing route limits are unchanged.
events.$comment_routes_people_v4: v4 lane U (2026-10-01): /admin/people (owner-only) is the Guests-style client table (C-00 DataTable with sort, density, pager, row click) plus the person cell with the lazy verified badge; the drawer loads on demand (next/dynamic). Measured 157.4 KB on macOS (Turbopack); 161 keeps >=3.5 KB for Linux CI gzip.
events.$comment_routes_door_v4: v4 lane K2 (2026-10-01): /admin/events/[id]/door is the whole door in one client island (the face engine state machine, camera hook, door API client and reducer, operator overlay, Test mode, PIN entry and the kiosk UI + its CSS-module map, moved from the removed Didit Access app where it measured 149.8 KB) plus the launcher; MediaPipe (~9 MB wasm/model) still loads by dynamic import after first paint. /admin/events/[id]/team is the event Team tab form. Measured on macOS 2026-10-01 (Turbopack): door 152.3 KB -> 156, team 147.3 KB -> 151. /admin/events/[id]/settings 150.5 KB (was 150): the event chrome gained the Door and Team tabs and the role-gated settings sections; budget 154. Each keeps >=3.5 KB for Linux CI gzip.

$comment_excluded: `exclude` route prefixes are reported but not budgeted: the /_frames gallery is a dev/test-only surface (404 in production unless FRAMES=1) and loads every UI component at once.
